claim: semantic-benchmark/1.3.4 qualifies P06 candidate behaviour on the support statuses SUFFICIENT, PARTIAL and INSUFFICIENT.

historical_claim_lineage.defect: The claim was carried forward verbatim, so an active version published a current claim naming a superseded one.
The version binding was repaired but the pre-decision coverage gate stayed the active state, so an active field still required a product decision Phase 9B.7 had made.

historical_claim_lineage.superseded_because: fresh pre-execution falsification found two fail-open N3 adjudication-population consumers outside the semantic claim

limitations: semantic-benchmark/1.3.4 does NOT qualify P06 UNCERTAIN behaviour.
P06 model-selection claims are limited to SUFFICIENT / PARTIAL / INSUFFICIENT.
UNCERTAIN remains an explicit residual risk.
Phase 9 alone does not establish full P06 contract coverage.
production_contract_note: UNCERTAIN remains a first-class member of the P06 support-status contract. 1.3.4 changes no production prompt, DTO, materializer or planner semantics; it repairs only N3 adjudication collection validation and preserves the narrowed U3 claim.
uncovered_is_not_unresolved: UNCOVERED is a fact about the instrument: no candidate-scoring P06 property asserts UNCERTAIN, so a qualification run cannot observe that behaviour. UNRESOLVED was a fact about the product: nobody had decided what to do about it. U3 decides what to do. It does not, and must not, make the status covered.
what_changed: Only the claim's explicit benchmark applicability advances to 1.3.4. The N3 executable repair does not change which semantic support-status behaviour is qualified.
why_a_new_hash: The claim text names the benchmark version it applies to; 1.3.4 may not publish a current claim naming superseded 1.3.3.
